newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Virgin to double S.Africa, U.K. flights.
newsitem.headline: Virgin to double S.Africa, U.K. flights.

text.p: Virgin Atlantic Airways announced on Friday that it would double the number of flights on its London-Johannesburg route to six flights a week in each direction from March 1.
The company said it had introduced the extra flights as a result of strong demand for its upper class, premium economy and economy flights.

"Virgin Atlantic Airways achieved a consistent, and massive, 85 percent load factor within just a few weeks of commencing flights on its latest international destination, prompting chairman Richard Branson to hail the Johannesburg-London route launch as 'the very best ever'," it said.
Virgin launched its London-Johannesburg route in October last year.
